title: Alicia
composer: [from Clair Obscur: Expedition 33] - Lorien Testard / Alice Duport-Percier
description: 《Alicia》，选自游戏《Clair Obscur: Expedition 33》原声带，Lorien Testard 与 Alice Duport-Percier 作曲，本曲为长笛改编版。c 小调的抒情旋律在 3/4 与 4/4 交替的律动中蜿蜒起伏，音域横跨三个八度，rubato 气息绵长，适合练习长乐句的歌唱性与力度层次。
descriptionEn: "Alicia", from the soundtrack of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, composed by Lorien Testard and Alice Duport-Percier, arranged for flute. A lyrical C-minor melody winds through alternating 3/4 and 4/4 motion, spanning three octaves with long, rubato breath — rewarding practice for singing long lines and shaping dynamics.
